method.sample_policy: Five independent processes per revision/case/platform; seeded randomized revision order within each round; platforms run sequentially; no CPU/load filtering.
method.limitations: Exploratory revision screen, not perf-gate. No battery, thermal or frequency history. No general causal attribution for the earlier low-rate session. No actor measurements in this screen.
